card.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
card.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

mechanism: A recruits B to move concealed evidence farther away while postponing what the envelope means.
confusable: Unlike merely hiding something personally, A must enlist B before disclosing the risk.
comparison: The family helper unknowingly becomes courier; the key holder bargains for limited disclosure and collection.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
